business_definition: Unique customer with at least one qualifying product activity during the trailing 30 days
formula: COUNT_DISTINCT(customer_id) filtered to Payment, Savings Deposit, Savings Withdrawal, or Credit Repayment

business_definition: Total unique customers in the customer base
Total revenue generated during the selected calendar month
Monthly revenue divided by certified active customers
Total value of payment activity during the selected period
Total balance held in savings accounts
Total original amount of loans originated during the selected period
Total outstanding balance across the current credit portfolio
Share of credit applications that were approved
Share of approved credit applications that were funded
formula: COUNT_DISTINCT(application_id where funded = 1) / COUNT_DISTINCT(application_id where approved = 1)

business_definition: Total unique credit applications received during the selected period
Average approved loan amount among approved applications
Percentage of loans that are 30 or more days past due
Percentage of outstanding balance associated with loans that are 30 or more days past due
Average risk score across credit applications
Share of customers with at least one product account
formula: COUNT_DISTINCT(customer_id in product_accounts) / COUNT_DISTINCT(customer_id in customers)

business_definition: Percentage of customers who remain active compared with the prior measurement period
formula: Retained active customers / prior-period active customers

business_definition: Revenue remaining after direct costs
Contribution margin expressed as a percentage of revenue
Share of outstanding credit balance held in the High or Very High risk bands
formula: SUM(outstanding_balance where risk_band IN ('High', 'Very High')) / SUM(outstanding_balance)
